mapper.select: select a.*,b.NAME as managerName from BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a left join BIZ_CAD_USER b on a.MANAGER = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
select a.*,b.NAME as managerName from BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a left join BIZ_CAD_USER b on a.MANAGER = b.ID where a.ID = #{prjId}

select a.*,b.NAME as stageName,b.SORT_INDEX as stageIndex,c.NAME as prjName from BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM a left join BIZ_CAD_STAGE b on a.STAGE_ID = b.ID left join BIZ_CAD_PROJECT c on a.PRJ_ID = c.ID where a.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'

select a.* from BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and ( a.MANAGER = #{cadUserId} or a.ID in ( select sub.PRJ_ID from BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM sub join BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM_USER subUser on sub.ID = subUser.SUB_ITEM_ID where sub.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and subUser.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and subUser.CAD_USER_ID = #{cadUserId} ) )

select distinct a.ID as prjId,a.NAME as prjName, e.ID as stageId,e.NAME as stageName, b.ID as subItemId,b.NAME as subItemName, f.ID as professionId,f.NAME as professionName, e.SORT_INDEX as stageIndex,f.SORT_INDEX as professionIndex from BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM b on b.PRJ_ID = a.ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM_USER c on c.SUB_ITEM_ID = b.ID and c.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_STAGE e on e.ID = b.STAGE_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_PROFESSION f on f.ID = c.PROFESSION_ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.ID as prjId,a.NAME as prjName, e.ID as stageId,e.NAME as stageName, b.ID as subItemId,b.NAME as subItemName, f.ID as professionId,f.NAME as professionName, file.ID as fId,file.PARENT_ID as fParentId,file.NAME as fName,file.TYPE as fType, file.CLOUD_POINTS as fCloudPoints,file.NOTE_POINTS as fNotePoints from BIZ_CAD_FILE file left join BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a on a.ID = file.PRJ_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM b on b.ID = file.SUB_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_STAGE e on e.ID = file.STAGE_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_PROFESSION f on f.ID = file.PROFESSION_ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
